description: This file contains a PHP class 'updateEndDate' which implements a logic hook to update the project's end date when a task's end date exceeds the current project end date in SuiteCRM. The class defines an 'update' method that performs this check and adjustment.

classes.name: updateEndDate
classes.description: A logic hook class that updates the project end date based on related task end dates in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Checks if the task's end date exceeds the linked project's estimated end date and updates the project accordingly.
